name: 6 Person, 2 Headed, 3 Person Game
objective: Given an activity or location, six players pair off into teams of three. Each team speaks one word at a time as three separate characters while playing a regular scene.

name: Actor’s Nightmare
objective: Given an activity or location, two players tell a story. One player is provided a script while the other improvises and fills in the gaps as the story unfolds.

name: Afterlife Group Therapy
objective: Four players have recently arrived in the afterlife. One player is the therapist helping them adjust. All players died from something inspired by one word, but each person must craft their backstory.

name: Ancient Prophecy
objective: An audience member retells a story while another person draws the events in pictograms. The players get 20 seconds to review the images, then retell the story using the drawings as guidance.

name: Back to Back Dubbing
objective: Players are given an activity and tell a story. Two players act out the story silently while two other players speak without seeing what actions are being taken, dubbing the silent actors.

name: Back to Back Switch/Change
objective: Given an activity that makes you want to move, two players face back and act as voices for the two players acting in front. When the bell rings, the host may switch voices or actions.

name: Ballet
objective: Audience members provide three suggestions: job, location, and object. Players use dancing to help the other players guess each suggestion, with a spin and bow to finish.

name: Blues Jam
objective: Four players, three blocks. The prompt is an annoyance. Each player gets a chance to sing a blues verse about their annoyance while the other players on their team provide backing.

name: Boris
objective: Two players. The prompt is the theme of the torture. Boris is an invisible bad cop. One player is a criminal and the other is the good cop, who repeatedly lets the criminal off.

name: Campfire Stories
objective: All players take turns telling a spooky story. The prompt is the title of the story.

name: Change
objective: Two players perform a scene based on an activity. The host dings and yells "change" to prompt a change in the action.

name: CSI Punsylvania
objective: A backline game of puns about how someone was murdered.

name: Death Trigger/Kill Word
objective: Players are given words from the audience based on a location suggestion. If a player says a kill word, that player selects someone to kill. If a player says the kill word again, consequences follow.

name: Evil Twin
objective: Two people play a scene with two evil twins on the side. The evil twins tap out their counterparts to do something evil. The non-evil twins then have to react.

name: Fork in the Road
objective: Two players start a scene based on an activity and establish big characters. The host stops the scene at a pivotal moment. Each next pair starts from the same stopping point with a new twist.

name: Four Square
objective: Four players perform mini scenes while rotating through a square. Each player has a prompt: thing, occupation, emotion, or location.

name: Goon River
objective: Three players perform monologues one at a time in line fashion. Each gives a different perspective on a joint narrative that took place in a location provided by the audience.

name: Hey Baby
objective: A backline game of sexy jokes based on various noun prompts.

name: Hey Santa, All I Want for Christmas Is a ______ Because…
objective: A backline game based on noun prompts about Christmas wishes.

name: Hey Waiter, There’s a _____ in My Rice
objective: A backline game based on noun prompts where an audience member has found something unexpected in their rice.

name: Hijacker
objective: Three players stay while one leaves the room. The audience provides an object used to hijack the group, a mode of transportation, and the location the trio is in.

name: Hydra PHD
objective: A hydra with multiple heads expertly answers questions about a given topic one word at a time.

name: Jeopardy
objective: Played like Jeopardy with questionable answers. Contestants introduce themselves. For each round, get a category and an answer, and each person responds in the form of a question.

name: Just a Cause
objective: A song game about a given cause, performed in a “We Are the World” style.

name: LCD
objective: Three players step out while one gets a location, career, and object of death. That player pantomimes it to the next player, who pantomimes to the next, creating a comedic sequence.

name: Little Voice
objective: Two players. The prompt is a location. The little voice is an object trying to persuade the other player to help them achieve a goal.

name: LOTUS
objective: Six players form three pairs. The first pair gets a relationship and starts the story. The second and third pairs are the same characters at future points. Each team continues the narrative.

name: Movie Critic (Holiday Special Review)
objective: A movie review-style game where hosts explain or review a holiday film chosen by the audience while two players act out different parts of it.

name: Musical Review
objective: Two hosts are part of a review show where they explain a musical chosen by the audience. Two players act out different small parts, usually in three total segments.

name: My Nickname Was…
objective: Players explain why their nickname back in the day, at school, or in any setting was based on the inserted noun prompt.

name: Objects in a Box
objective: Objects are chosen by an audience member and placed in three closed boxes. Without knowing the objects, each player gives a setup monologue, eventually opens a box, and incorporates the object.

name: Other Worldly Advocate
objective: One player is the straight man while two angel/devil players give advice. The straight man makes decisions based on the location or activity, and the angel/devil argue.

name: Party Quirks
objective: One player hosts a party attended by three others. The audience gives quirks or characters for the attendees to embody. The guests give hints, and the host tries to guess.

name: Rashomon
objective: Three players perform a scene based on a location with clear personalities. The host dings, and the scene is replayed from each character’s point of view.

name: Realtor
objective: A realtor gives a tour to two people. The theme of the house is the prompt. Scene one is the tour, and scene two is the couple existing in the space as the homeowners.

name: Ride Share
objective: Four chairs are placed like a car. One player is the driver for the whole game. One by one, each actor enters as a passenger and does a short scene with the driver.

name: Rumors
objective: All-player game. A prompt is given, usually a text or weird thing someone heard. Each player passes along a rumor that changes slightly until the original place is revealed.

name: Scenes from a Hat
objective: All-game format. A prompt is given and players act out scenes based on that prompt.

name: Seed Word
objective: Six players split into three teams of two. Based on an audience word, each team performs a small four-line scene. The audience eliminates their least favorite to move forward.

name: Serenade
objective: An adult volunteer is interviewed by the host about their name, job, hobbies, and interesting details. A track plays and the players sing R&B-style pick-up lines.

name: Slideshow
objective: Based on an audience-given location, one player gives a monologue describing a trip. Behind them, the rest pose as slideshow images. When the speaker says a cue, images change.

name: Soap Opera
objective: A multi-part game with four players. They establish a scene based on a location, then continue it with an audience-given twist, then continue again with a different emotional cue.

name: Sounds Like a Song
objective: Four players act out a scene based on an activity. If the host hears a line they like, they stop the scene and say "That Sounds Like a Song!" The player sings a short chorus.

name: Sounds Like a Song Survivor
objective: A mash-up of Sounds Like a Song and Survivor. Four players do a scene, the host can pause for songs, then one player sits out and the remaining players replace them.

name: Survivor
objective: Four players act out a scene based on an activity. After the scene ends, one player sits and the remaining players replay the scene while covering all four personalities.

name: Top That
objective: Two players at a time. One pantomimes an action and says "I’m doing X, top that." The other uses the same motion to justify a new activity. Players go back and forth.

name: Understudy
objective: Four or more players start a scene based on a location. The host can ding and substitute actors from the wings, switch actors on stage, add or remove actors, and alter the scene.

name: Voices from Heaven
objective: Four players speak in turn, starting with brief introductions, then sharing more detail, then wrapping up the story. The story is about the day all players died.

name: What’s the Matter with Stephen?
objective: Three players. Two are sent out while the audience gives Stephen’s problem and what will make Stephen feel better. Stephen speaks only in gibberish. The audience guides the scene.

name: Where Are These Chairs
objective: Two chairs are set center stage. Two actors ask, "Where are these chairs?" The host gives a location, they do a short scene, one actor leaves, another joins, and the scene continues.

name: Wikipedia
objective: All-player lineup game. The host gets a subject to search Wikipedia for. Actors step forward to give made-up or real facts. Others can yell "edit" to take over.

name: Work Excuse
objective: Three players. One leaves while the audience gives the reason they are late for work. The boss questions them while the coworker pantomimes the excuse behind them.

name: Yo Mama
objective: All-player lineup game. The host says a noun and actors step forward with a one-liner insult using "yo mama is a..." or "your mama is like a..." The audience reacts.

name: You Dirty Rat
objective: All-player lineup game. The host gives nouns and actors step forward saying, "You dirty rat, they call me the _____ because _____," explaining the nickname.
